_meta.description: iSBD + PRR slide template definitions. Each slide type defines layout, regions, and field mappings to deal data. SRR iSBD is the primary document; PRR reuses the same deal data with additional financial/approval slides.
_meta.template_source: IBM Consulting iSBD Template 2025 Edition v3.5.8

backgrounds._note: Standard iSBD slide backgrounds extracted from IBM Consulting template. Files in /isbd-bg/.

cover.title: Cover
cover.description: Title slide with IBM branding, client/deal identifiers in a single-column table.

regions.note: IBM logo — preserved from template media

regions.content: IBM Confidential: Integrated Solution Baseline Document (iSBD)

key_changes.title: Key Changes Since Last Submission
key_changes.description: Summary of scope/commercial changes since last submission. Dynamic row table plus narrative callout shapes.

regions.note: Free-text executive narrative about the changes

deal_profile_summary.title: Deal Profile Summary
deal_profile_summary.description: The densest slide — 9 tables covering profile, dates, financials, complexity, team, incumbent status, sub-K, GenAI, and IBM consulting lines.

rows.label: Client to IBM re-badging in scope?
Third Parties / Subcontractor value included in TCV

regions.title: IBM Consulting Lines
regions.description: Which IBM Consulting service lines are involved and which is lead, with TCV allocation.
rows_template: Business Applications / BTS – Data & Tech Transformation (DTT)
Hybrid Cloud & Data / BTS – Finance & Supply Chain Transformation (FCS)

solution_history.title: Solution History

condition.note: Only include for Repeat / Bid Repair deals, never for first-time submissions

solution_history.description: Tracks evolution of the solution across submissions. Columns are added for each submission date. Rows are fixed solution elements.

proposed_timeline.title: IBM Proposed Timeline
proposed_timeline.description: Project timeline visual (typically a Gantt chart screenshot from the timeline tool) plus optional narrative text about adjustments.

regions.note: Embedded from timeline tool or uploaded image

scope_summary.title: Levers of Scope
scope_summary.description: Two-row scope table covering project scope, business process, applications, organization, and delivery approach.

wricef_count.title: WRICEF Count
wricef_count.description: Embedded chart/table image showing WRICEF breakdown by type (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Form).

assumptions.title: Assumptions
assumptions.description: Repeatable slide type. Each instance has a title (e.g. 'Assumptions – Finance') and a rich-text body. Multiple slides per functional area.

subcontractor_detail.title: Sub-Contractor
subcontractor_detail.description: Lists all sub-contractors and their scope descriptions.

ocm_scope.title: Organizational Change Management Scope & Key Metrics
ocm_scope.description: Left column: project scope by release. Right column: staffing breakdown.

key_resources.title: Key Resources
key_resources.description: Before/after staffing comparison — typically an embedded image from GSSM.

financial_summary.title: Services Financial Summary
financial_summary.description: Financial summary chart (from GSSM/GPE) plus assumptions text about risk rating, billing, payment terms.

regions.note: Auto-composed from: risk_rating, billing_timing, payment_terms, genai_price

genai.title: GenAI Solution Components
genai.description: GenAI solution architecture or component diagram.

onshore_offshore_mix.title: Onshore / Offshore Mix & Band Mix
onshore_offshore_mix.description: Two charts side by side: onshore/offshore resource split and band mix distribution.

deal_financials_by_team.title: Deal Financials by Team
deal_financials_by_team.description: Cost breakdown by functional team — embedded chart from GSSM.

key_deal_aspects.title: Key Deal Aspects
key_deal_aspects.description: Bullet list of win strategy, differentiators, approach highlights.

deal_timeline_context.title: Deal Timeline & Context
deal_timeline_context.description: Monthly sales cycle narrative with positioned text boxes. Shows RFI, RFP, downselect, orals, BAFO milestones.

srr_action_items.title: SRR Action Items
srr_action_items.description: Action items from SRR board review. May span multiple slides.

solution_changes.title: Solution & Staffing Changes
solution_changes.description: Table showing scope changes: Scope Area, Original Assumption, New Requirement, Changes.

risk_assessment.title: Risk Assessment
risk_assessment.description: RCA questions table + Key Risks table with probability, impact, mitigation, and timing. First instance also has the risk review metadata (date, consultant, TDA reviewer, etc.).

executive_summary.title: Executive Summary & Solution Strategy
executive_summary.description: PRR-specific. Client ask narrative, engagement type, engagement source, win themes, key requirements mapped to L30 offerings, solution summary, review status.

additional_deal_profile.title: Additional Deal Profile Information
additional_deal_profile.description: PRR-specific supplementary deal profile data: incumbent details, contract specifics, and additional complexity indicators.

rows.label: Client to IBM Re-badging in Scope?

solution_maps.title: Solution Maps (Current / Future)
solution_maps.description: Current-state and future-state solution architecture diagrams.

custom_development.title: Custom Development / Remediation
custom_development.description: Custom object count and remediation approach (e.g. SmartShift).

key_proposed_resources.title: Key Proposed Resources
key_proposed_resources.description: Named resource table with role, band, dates, load factor.

bid_metrics.title: Bid Metrics / GSSM
bid_metrics.description: GSSM output charts showing bid metrics.

detailed_staffing.title: Detailed Staffing Model
detailed_staffing.description: Full staffing breakdown image from GSSM.

tda.title: Technical Delivery Assessment (TDA)
tda.description: TDA results: key risks, complexity assessment, narrative, and reviewer info.

compliance_review.title: Compliance and Review Status
compliance_review.description: Two tables: Compliance checklist (PM&T, RHOCP, estimation, etc.) and Solution Reviews checklist (global solutioning, staffing, risk).

actions_to_close.title: Actions to Close Before Contract Signed
actions_to_close.description: Action items needed before contract execution.

key_challenges.title: Key Challenges to Meet Target Price
key_challenges.description: Challenges table plus target win price and methodology.

business_value_drivers.title: Key IBM Business Value Drivers
business_value_drivers.description: BVD dashboard screenshot from Solution Workbench.

raci.title: RACI
raci.description: Responsibility matrix: Activity × IBM / IBM 3rd Parties / Client.

staffing_approvals.title: Staffing and Approvals
staffing_approvals.description: Delivery locations with band mix and approval status, plus demand/staffability info and resourcing risks.

mandatory_assets.title: Mandatory / Applicable Assets Inclusion
mandatory_assets.description: Asset inclusion checklist, non-inclusion details, PRR section confirmations, and approval status.

pi_po_interfaces.title: PI/PO Interfaces
pi_po_interfaces.description: Interface migration diagram and narrative for PI/PO to BTP migration.

back_slide.title: Back Cover
back_slide.description: IBM closing slide with template version and copyright.
